cohort: 589 women presenting to the obstetrical departments of two Ministry of Public Health and Population (MSPP)-affiliated public hospitals in the North East region of Haiti.
finding: Point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) has the potential to improve the care of obstetrical patients in the North East region of Haiti, specifically by assisting in the diagnosis of conditions such as multi-gestations, non-vertex presentation, and placental abruption.
